bullets.text: Residents in Thiruvallur blocked roads at night to protest continuous power cuts, and the office should monitor electricity restoration.
Motorists expressed fear as the high-level bridge across the Arani River near Ponneri was damaged, and the office must inspect repairs.
ITI students assaulted a government bus conductor in Avadi for questioning them, and the office should watch student discipline.
PMK leader accused officials of a conspiracy to destroy the Pallikaranai wetland, and the office should verify these environmental claims.
A 44-year-old man was run over by a truck after falling from his two-wheeler in Madhavaram, and the office should review traffic safety.
Two cows and a deer died due to electrocution near Ponneri, and the office must coordinate safety checks with electricity board officials.
CMWSSB invited bids for a desalination plant at Minjur, and the office should track the project's infrastructure progress.
Vyoma.AI broke ground on a 52 MW AI-ready green data center in Chennai, and the office should support local tech investments.
Experts noted AI boosts training quality in aviation but cannot replace pilots, and the office should monitor industry adoption trends.
A viral post in Bengaluru sparked debates over expensive AI subscriptions, and the office should observe digital tool pricing impacts.
Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay inaugurated residential and business complexes worth over one thousand crore rupees, and the office should track public housing rollout.
